metadata.title: Parse Repository List
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Parse a comma-separated repository list parameter into a structured repositories-list.json file, determining source type and validating entries. Use when a process receives a list of repository references that need to be normalized, classified, and validated before downstream per-repository processing.

output.description: Structured repository list with classification and validation metadata

prerequisites: repositoryList parameter available in process context (from process.json parameters or memory.json)
specificActions: Read the repositoryList parameter from process.json parameters or memory.json
Split the comma-separated string by comma and trim whitespace from each entry
Classify each entry by source type: remote-url (http/https/git@/ssh prefix or .git suffix), local-path (/, ./, ~, or drive letter prefix), or unknown
Extract repository name: last path segment for URLs (strip .git), last directory name for local paths
Validate each entry: non-empty after trim, basic format check; set valid:false with validationNote for invalid entries
Build the repositories-list.json structure with metadata (counts, source type breakdown) and repositories array
Write repositories-list.json to the process folder
Record: summary statistics (repositoryCount, validCount, invalidCount, sourceTypeSummary, repositoriesListPath)
tools: list_dir - Optionally validate local paths exist
bestPractices: Keep it lightweight -- no network calls, no cloning
Handle edge cases: trailing commas, extra spaces, empty entries between commas
Preserve the original entry as rawEntry for debugging and traceability
Mark invalid entries with valid:false but do not fail the step -- let downstream steps decide
Save results to separate JSON file to keep memory.json clean (following identify-files pattern)

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Read operating principles and confirm them before starting this step
actions: Read `~/.claude/agentic-processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: 'Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Read repositoryList Parameter
substeps.description: Locate and read the repositoryList parameter from process context
actions: Read process.json to locate the repositoryList parameter
If not in process.json parameters, check memory.json for the value from a previous step
Store the raw string for processing
Log the parameter source and raw value to log.json

substeps.name: Split and Trim Entries
substeps.description: Split the comma-separated string into individual entries and normalize whitespace
actions: Split the comma-separated string by comma delimiter
Trim whitespace from each entry
Track completely empty entries as skipped (do not include in final output)
Log: total entries found, empty entries skipped

substeps.name: Classify and Validate Each Entry
substeps.description: Determine source type and validate format for each repository entry
actions: For each entry, determine sourceType using prefix-based heuristics:
remote-url: starts with http://, https://, git@, ssh://; or contains .git suffix
local-path: starts with /, ./, ~, or a drive letter like C:
unknown: cannot determine type from format
Extract name: for remote URLs use last path segment stripped of .git suffix; for local paths use last directory name
Validate: non-empty after trimming, basic format check for source type
Set valid:true or valid:false with validationNote explaining the issue

substeps.name: Build repositories-list.json Structure
substeps.description: Assemble the complete JSON output structure with metadata and repositories array
actions: Create the top-level structure with type:'repositories-list'
Compute metadata: generatedAt timestamp, totalCount, bySourceType counts
Build repositories array with index, name, rawEntry, sourceType, url, localPath, valid, validationNote for each entry
For remote-url entries: set url field, localPath null
For local-path entries: set localPath field, url null
For unknown entries: both url and localPath null

substeps.name: Write Output File and Update Memory
substeps.description: Write the structured JSON to disk and update process memory with summary statistics
actions: Write repositories-list.json to the process folder
Record: informationProduced -
repositoryCount (total), validCount, invalidCount, sourceTypeSummary (breakdown by type), repositoriesListPath
Record: decisionsMade: classification decisions, validation choices
Record: filesModifiedCreated: path to repositories-list.json
Record: crossReferences for new decisions and files
Record: all actions taken in this step

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify operating principles were followed throughout this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated with actions taken?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: If any user interaction occurred, was pending-interaction.json created and later deleted?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Read repositoryList parameter -> Split and trim entries -> Classify source type and validate each entry -> Build structured JSON with metadata -> Write output file and update memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Process parameters (process.json) or previous step section in memory.json - repositoryList comma-separated string
fields: Information Produced: repositoryCount, validCount, invalidCount, sourceTypeSummary, repositoriesListPath
Decisions Made: Source type classification choices, validation decisions

repositoryList.description: Comma-separated list of repository references (remote URLs or local filesystem paths)
